summary: The note describes Fed Cup, the premier international team competition in women's tennis. It was launched in 1963 to mark the 50th anniversary of the International Tennis Federation (ITF) and was called the Federation Cup until 1995. The note says it is the world's largest annual women's international team sports competition by number of nations, and names Katrina Adams as current Chairperson.
one_line: Fed Cup is the premier international women's tennis team competition, launched in 1963 by the ITF and renamed from the Federation Cup in 1995.
key_facts: Fed Cup is the premier international team competition in women's tennis.
Fed Cup was launched in 1963 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the International Tennis Federation (ITF).
The competition was known as the Federation Cup until 1995.
Fed Cup is the world's largest annual women's international team sports competition in terms of the number of nations that compete.
The current Fed Cup Chairperson is Katrina Adams.
